Product Description:
Topps is thrilled to announce the return of the Arsenal Collector Tin for the 2026/27 season.

The Arsenal Collector Tin 2026/27 brings the excitement of Arsenal trading cards to fans and collectors alike. Featuring 35 cards, this release is packed with big names from across generations, all in a premium collector tin.

Every tin includes two sequentially numbered parallel cards, giving collectors a guaranteed hit in every opening while lucky tins also contain special autograph cards.

Start your collecting journey with the Base Cards showcasing today’s first-team men’s and women’s favourites, alongside emerging young players who represent the future of the club. It’s the perfect way to start or grow your Arsenal collection.

Brand new for this season, the For The Badge subset celebrates players whose passion and dedication have left (or will leave) a lasting mark on the club, mixing modern heroes with historic icons.

For the second year running, chase the Gold Vault Limited Edition cards, featuring a bold gold design and a premium checklist that highlights the very best Arsenal players, past and present.

Finally, Base Card Autographs bring even more excitement, with signatures from a selection of current and ex- Arsenal players. Look out for the ultra-rare 1/1 Gold Foilfractor Autographs, a true collector’s dream.
